main_body: Marble column: a wider capital (rows 8-15), a shaft (rows 16-39) and a wider base (rows 40-47).
top_band: Capital top: light grey (L=231) rows 9-11, then a white front-edge line at row 12, so about 4 light rows. It sits above a darker front lip (rows 13-14, L=183/155) and an outline at row 15. The shaft below is L=183/121.
evidence: In the x=8 column the capital has 3 light rows (9-11) and a white edge line (row 12). Below them are 2 darker front-lip rows (13-14), then an outline row and a clearly darker shaft. The capital is wider than the shaft and its top corners are cut. That reads as a plate wider than the shaft, about 4 rows tall and clearly lighter than the shaft, not a 1-3px flat band. The base repeats the pattern (light rows 41-43, white line 44, shaded rows 45-46). The cap is borderline but just meets the contract.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours and a median of 8 colours per tile, against 17-20 per tile and 38-40 colours in the references. The dark edge pixels are 100% near-neutral (a grey outline, not a tinted material tone), whereas the references are 1% and 33%. The shaft is smooth vertical gradient stripes with no marble veining, chips, grain or speckle. The capital has only a few stripes. Next to the stall and the well it looks thinner and more sticker-like.
